name: Alpen Caravan Park Achensee
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The **Alpen Caravan Park Achensee** is located in **Achenkirch** on the northern shore of the **Achensee**. The area is characterized by the **Karwendel** and **Rofangebirge** mountains. The site offers a peaceful atmosphere nestled between the mountains and the lake. Nearby, there are **hiking trails** and **ski resorts** like Christlum. The facilities include **sanitary amenities**, **electricity outlets**, and a **local market**. Guests will find a well-equipped campsite with direct **lake access**.
